cafe-creme--cafe-creme-original.description: Henri Wintermans introduced Café Crème in 1963, and the Original remains its core miniature: a short Dutch-made cigarillo with a Java wrapper over dry-cured tobaccos from Java, Colombia, the Dominican Republic and Italy. Renamed Signature in 2019 in some markets, it smokes smooth and gently sweet, with soft touches of vanilla and chocolate.

cafe-creme--cafe-creme-blue.description: The Blue is a small Henri Wintermans cigarillo made in Holland from dry-cured tobaccos, with Dominican leaf in the blend, and one of the brand's mainstays in the British miniature market. Now sold there as Signature Blue, it gives a short, smooth smoke, creamy and lightly sweet, with hints of vanilla, chocolate and coffee.

cafe-creme--cafe-creme-express.description: Café Crème Express is a miniature smaller than the brand's classic minis, about 70 mm with an 18 ring gauge, made for a short smoke where time or space is limited. Unveiled in Paris and sold in crush-proof tins of ten, it came in Original and Blue styles: a light Ecuadorian wrapper over Brazilian, Colombian, Dominican and Java tobaccos, mild, creamy and subtly sweet.
